sentences.text:
Contempt Case No.758 of 2024
Order:
This Contempt Case is filed alleging violation of the common order passed by this Court in
W.P.No.29381 of 2022, dated 16.10.2023.
2.
This Court, vide order, dated 16.10.2023, while disposing of the s

aid writ petition directed the respondents to conclude the acquisition proceedings, as expeditiously as possible and further directed the Land Acquisition Officer (LAO) to take into consideration the aspect of awarding interest from the date of taking over possession of the land, under Section 80 of the Act, 2013.

3. A counter affidavit has been filed by respondent No.2 stating that formation of the bypass road from Ragudu Village of Sircilla Mandal to Venkatapur Village of Yellareddipet Mandal, Rajanna Siricilla District including the land to an extent of Acs.16 guntas in Sy.No.1268 of Ragudu Village has been completed; the entire process has come to a conclusion; the respondents have addressed a letter to the District Collector to obtain the last three years sales statistics to prepare the award;
CVBR, J CC_758_2024 after collecting the sales statistics, the award shall be prepared and compensation will be paid to the petitioners as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4. Since it is stated that the respondents have completed laying of the bypass road and the compensation to the petitioners would be paid, after collecting the sales statistics, there is no wilful and deliberate violation on the part of the respondents in implementation of the order, dated 16.10.2023 passed by this Court in W.P.No.29381 of 2022, for initiating contempt proceedings against them.
5.
Accordingly, this Contempt Case is closed.
6. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

______________________________ JUSTICE C.V.BHASKAR REDDY Date: 13.09.2024 sus Peddaveni Yamuna vs Sri. Anurag Jayanthi on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26031485/
